Combat Superiority.desc_long: You learn three maneuvers (two more at 7th, 10th, and 15th level; you can swap one each time you learn new ones). You can use only one maneuver per attack. You have four d8 superiority dice, gaining another at 7th and 15th level, and regain all on a short or long rest. Maneuver save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).

Student of War.title: Student of War
Student of War.desc_long: You gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.

Know Your Enemy.title: Know Your Enemy
Know Your Enemy.desc_long: After observing or interacting with a creature outside combat for at least 1 minute, you learn whether it is your equal, superior, or inferior in two characteristics of your choice: Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Armor Class, current hit points, total class levels, or fighter levels.

Improved Combat Superiority.title: Improved Combat Superiority
Improved Combat Superiority.desc_long: Your superiority dice become d10s, and d12s at 18th level.

Relentless.title: Relentless
Relentless.desc_long: When you roll initiative and have no superiority dice left, you regain one.

Bonus Proficiency.title: Bonus Proficiency
Bonus Proficiency.desc_long: You gain proficiency in one of Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion, or you learn one language of your choice.

Born to the Saddle.title: Born to the Saddle
Born to the Saddle.desc_long: You have advantage on saves to avoid falling off your mount. If you fall off and descend no more than 10 feet, you can land on your feet if you're not incapacitated. Mounting or dismounting costs only 5 feet of movement.

Unwavering Mark.title: Unwavering Mark
Unwavering Mark.duration: Until end of your next turn
Unwavering Mark.desc_long: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can mark it until the end of your next turn (ends early if you're incapacitated or die, or someone else marks it). While within 5 feet of you, a marked creature has disadvantage on attack rolls that don't target you. If it damages anyone other than you, you can make a special melee attack against it as a bonus action on your next turn, with advantage and extra damage equal to half your fighter level. You can do this a number of times equal to your Strength modifier (minimum once).

Warding Maneuver.title: Warding Maneuver
Warding Maneuver.desc_long: If you or a creature you can see within 5 feet is hit by an attack and you wield a melee weapon or shield, you can roll 1d8 and add it to the target's AC against that attack. If the attack still hits, the target has resistance to its damage. You can do this a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum once).

Hold the Line.title: Hold the Line
Hold the Line.desc_long: Creatures provoke an opportunity attack from you when they move 5 feet or more while within your reach. If you hit with that opportunity attack, the target's speed becomes 0 until the end of the current turn.

Ferocious Charger.title: Ferocious Charger
Ferocious Charger.desc_long: If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line right before attacking and you hit, the target must succeed on a Strength save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength modifier) or be knocked prone. Once per turn.

Vigilant Defender.title: Vigilant Defender
Vigilant Defender.desc_long: In combat you get a special reaction you can use once on every creature's turn except your own, only to make an opportunity attack. You can't use it on a turn when you take your normal reaction.

Improved Critical.title: Improved Critical
Improved Critical.desc_long: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

Remarkable Athlete.title: Remarkable Athlete
Remarkable Athlete.desc_long: You add half your proficiency bonus (rounded up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check that doesn't already use your proficiency bonus. Your running long jump distance increases by a number of feet equal to your Strength modifier.

Additional Fighting Style.title: Additional Fighting Style
Additional Fighting Style.desc_long: You choose a second option from the Fighting Style class feature.

Superior Critical.title: Superior Critical
Superior Critical.desc_long: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.

Survivor.title: Survivor
Survivor.desc_long: At the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half your hit points left. This doesn't work if you have 0 hit points.

Manifest Echo.title: Manifest Echo
Manifest Echo.desc_long: You manifest a translucent echo of yourself in an unoccupied space you can see within 15 feet. It lasts until destroyed, dismissed as a bonus action, replaced by another echo, or you are incapacitated. It has AC 14 + your proficiency bonus, 1 hit point, immunity to all conditions, and uses your saving throw bonuses. It is your size, and you can mentally command it to move up to 30 feet each turn with no action; if it ends your turn more than 30 feet from you, it is destroyed. As a bonus action you can swap places with it at a cost of 15 feet of movement. Attacks you make with the Attack action can originate from your space or its space. When a creature you can see within 5 feet of the echo moves 5 feet or more away from it, you can use your reaction to make an opportunity attack as though you were in the echo's space.
Manifest Echo.desc_short: You manifest a translucent echo of yourself in an unoccupied space you can see within 15 feet. It lasts until destroyed, dismissed as a bonus action, replaced by another echo, or you are incapacitated.

Unleash Incarnation.title: Unleash Incarnation
Unleash Incarnation.desc_long: Whenever you take the Attack action, you can make one additional melee attack from the echo's position. You can do this a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum once).

Echo Avatar.title: Echo Avatar
Echo Avatar.desc_long: You see and hear through your echo for up to 10 minutes, ending it at will with no action. You are deafened and blinded while doing so. During this time the echo can be up to 1,000 feet from you without being destroyed.

Shadow Martyr.title: Shadow Martyr
Shadow Martyr.desc_long: Before an attack roll is made against another creature you can see, you can teleport your echo to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the targeted creature. The attack is then made against your echo instead.

Reclaim Potential.title: Reclaim Potential
Reclaim Potential.desc_long: When an echo of yours is destroyed by taking damage, you can gain temporary hit points equal to 2d6 + your Constitution modifier, if you don't already have temporary hit points. You can do this a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum once).

Legion of One.title: Legion of One
Legion of One.desc_long: You can create two echoes with Manifest Echo as a bonus action, and they can coexist. Creating a third destroys the previous two. Anything you can do from one echo's position you can do from the other's. When you roll initiative and have no uses of Unleash Incarnation left, you regain one.

Spellcasting.title: Spellcasting
Spellcasting.desc_long: You cast wizard spells using Intelligence (spell save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier; spell attack = proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier). You learn two wizard cantrips (a third at 10th level) and know spells per this progression, by fighter level: 3rd 3 spells, 4th 4, 7th 5, 8th 6, 10th 7, 11th 8, 13th 9, 14th 10, 16th 11, 19th 12, 20th 13. Slots per level: 3rd 2 first-level; 4th 3 first; 7th 4 first and 2 second; 10th 3 second; 13th 2 third; 16th 3 third; 19th 1 fourth. Slots are regained on a long rest. Most spells you learn must be abjuration or evocation, but the spells gained at 3rd (one of the three), 8th, 14th, and 20th level can be from any school. You can swap one known spell whenever you gain a fighter level, following the same restriction.
Spellcasting.desc_short: You cast wizard spells using Intelligence (spell save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier; spell attack = proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier). You learn two wizard cantrips (a third at 10th level).

Weapon Bond.title: Weapon Bond
Weapon Bond.desc_long: Through a 1-hour ritual (can be done during a short rest) you bond with a weapon within reach. You can't be disarmed of it unless incapacitated, and if it is on the same plane you can summon it to your hand as a bonus action. You can have two bonded weapons but summon only one at a time. Bonding a third breaks one of the first two.

War Magic.title: War Magic
War Magic.desc_long: When you use your action to cast a cantrip, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

Eldritch Strike.title: Eldritch Strike
Eldritch Strike.duration: Until end of your next turn
Eldritch Strike.desc_long: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, it has disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

Arcane Charge.title: Arcane Charge
Arcane Charge.desc_long: When you use Action Surge, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, before or after the additional action.

Improved War Magic.title: Improved War Magic
Improved War Magic.desc_long: When you use your action to cast a spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

Psionic Power.title: Psionic Power
Psionic Power.desc_long:
You have Psionic Energy dice (d6s) equal to twice your proficiency bonus. The die size becomes d8 at 5th level, d10 at 11th, and d12 at 17th. You regain all expended dice on a long rest, and as a bonus action you can regain one die once per short or long rest.
Protective Field (reaction): when you or a creature within 30 ft takes damage, expend a die and reduce the damage by the roll + INT modifier.
Psionic Strike: once per turn, after hitting a target within 30 ft with a weapon, expend a die to deal force damage equal to the roll + INT modifier.
Telekinetic Movement (action): move a loose Large-or-smaller object or willing creature (not you) within 30 ft up to 30 ft, or a Tiny object to or from your hand; once per short or long rest unless you expend a die.
Psionic Power.desc_short: You have Psionic Energy dice (d6s) equal to twice your proficiency bonus. The die size becomes d8 at 5th level, d10 at 11th, and d12 at 17th. You regain all expended dice on a long rest, and as a bonus action you can regain one die once per short or long rest.

Telekinetic Adept.title: Telekinetic Adept
Telekinetic Adept.desc_long:
Psi-Powered Leap (bonus action): you gain a flying speed of twice your walking speed until the end of the turn; once per short or long rest unless you expend a die.
Telekinetic Thrust: when you deal damage with Psionic Strike, the target makes a Strength save (DC 8 + prof bonus + INT modifier) or you knock it prone or move it up to 10 feet horizontally.

Guarded Mind.title: Guarded Mind
Guarded Mind.desc_long: You have resistance to psychic damage. If you start your turn charmed or frightened, you can expend a Psionic Energy die to end every effect on you causing those conditions.

Bulwark of Force.title: Bulwark of Force
Bulwark of Force.desc_long: Choose creatures you can see within 30 feet (can include you), up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one). Each gains half cover for 1 minute or until you're incapacitated. Once per long rest unless you expend a Psionic Energy die.

Telekinetic Master.title: Telekinetic Master
Telekinetic Master.desc_long: You can cast Telekinesis with no components, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability. On each of your turns while concentrating on it, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action. Once per long rest unless you expend a Psionic Energy die.

Bonus Proficiencies.title: Bonus Proficiencies
Bonus Proficiencies.desc_long: You gain proficiency with smith's tools and learn to speak, read, and write Giant.

Rune Carver.title: Rune Carver
Rune Carver.desc_long: You learn two runes, then 3 at 7th level, 4 at 10th, and 5 at 15th. You can swap one rune for another whenever you gain a fighter level. After a long rest, you inscribe a different rune on each of that many objects you touch. Each lasts until your next long rest. Rune Magic save DC = 8 + prof bonus + CON modifier. Each rune's invocation can be used once per short or long rest.

Giant's Might.title: Giant's Might
Giant's Might.desc_long: For 1 minute, if you are smaller than Large you become Large (if there is room), you have advantage on Strength checks and saves, and once on each of your turns one weapon or unarmed attack deals an extra 1d6 damage. The extra damage becomes 1d8 at 10th level and 1d10 at 18th. You can use this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus.

Runic Shield.title: Runic Shield
Runic Shield.desc_long: When another creature you can see within 60 feet is hit by an attack roll, you can force the attacker to reroll the d20 and use the new roll. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus.

Great Stature.title: Great Stature
Great Stature.desc_long: You permanently grow a number of inches equal to a roll of 3d4. The extra damage from Giant's Might increases to 1d8.

Master of Runes.title: Master of Runes
Master of Runes.desc_long: You can invoke each rune you know from Rune Carver twice rather than once, regaining all expended uses on a short or long rest.

Runic Juggernaut.title: Runic Juggernaut
Runic Juggernaut.desc_long: The extra damage from Giant's Might increases to 1d10. When you use that feature, your size can become Huge, and while Huge your reach increases by 5 feet.

Bonus Proficiency.title: Bonus Proficiency
Bonus Proficiency.desc_long: You gain proficiency in one of History, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion, or you learn one language of your choice.

Fighting Spirit.title: Fighting Spirit
Fighting Spirit.desc_long: As a bonus action, you gain advantage on all weapon attack rolls until the end of the current turn and gain 5 temporary hit points (10 at 10th level, 15 at 15th). You can use this three times, regaining all uses on a long rest.

Elegant Courtier.title: Elegant Courtier
Elegant Courtier.desc_long: When you make a Charisma (Persuasion) check, you add your Wisdom modifier. You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws, or, if you already have it, in Intelligence or Charisma saves (your choice).

Tireless Spirit.title: Tireless Spirit
Tireless Spirit.desc_long: When you roll initiative and have no uses of Fighting Spirit left, you regain one use.

Rapid Strike.title: Rapid Strike
Rapid Strike.desc_long: If you take the Attack action and have advantage on an attack roll against a target, you can forgo that advantage to make one additional weapon attack against the same target as part of the same action. Once per turn.

Strength Before Death.title: Strength Before Death
Strength Before Death.desc_long: If damage would reduce you to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to delay falling unconscious and immediately take an extra turn. While at 0 hit points during that turn, damage causes death save failures as normal, and three failures can still kill you. When the turn ends you fall unconscious if you still have 0 hit points.

13: Tongue of the Sun and Moon

Arms of the Astral Self.title: Arms of the Astral Self
Arms of the Astral Self.desc_long: Spend 1 ki point to summon spectral arms. Each creature of your choice that you can see within 10 feet must succeed on a DEX save or take force damage equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die. The arms last 10 minutes (vanishing early if you are incapacitated or die). While they are present, you can use your WIS modifier instead of STR for STR checks and saves; you can make unarmed strikes with them, with 5 feet of extra reach; and those strikes can use Wisdom instead of Strength or Dexterity for attack and damage rolls and deal force damage.
Arms of the Astral Self.desc_short: Spend 1 ki point to summon spectral arms. Each creature of your choice that you can see within 10 feet must succeed on a DEX save or take force damage equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die. The arms last 10 minutes (vanishing early if you are incapacitated or die).

Visage of the Astral Self.title: Visage of the Astral Self
Visage of the Astral Self.desc_long:
As a bonus action, or as part of the bonus action that activates the arms, spend 1 ki point to summon a spectral visage for 10 minutes (it vanishes early if you are incapacitated or die).
Astral Sight: you see normally in magical and nonmagical darkness to 120 feet.
Wisdom of the Spirit: advantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Charisma (Intimidation) checks.
Word of the Spirit: you can direct your words so that only one creature you can see within 60 feet hears them, or amplify your voice so every creature within 600 feet hears.
Visage of the Astral Self.desc_short: As a bonus action, or as part of the bonus action that activates the arms, spend 1 ki point to summon a spectral visage for 10 minutes (it vanishes early if you are incapacitated or die).

Body of the Astral Self.title: Body of the Astral Self
Body of the Astral Self.desc_long:
When both your arms and visage are summoned, your astral body appears with no action required.
Deflect Energy: when you take acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, or thunder damage, you can use your reaction to reduce it by 1d10 + your Wisdom modifier (minimum reduction of 1).
Empowered Arms: once on each of your turns when you hit a target with the astral arms, you deal extra damage equal to your Martial Arts die.
Body of the Astral Self.desc_short: When both your arms and visage are summoned, your astral body appears with no action required.

Awakened Astral Self.title: Awakened Astral Self
Awakened Astral Self.desc_long:
Spend 5 ki points to summon the arms, visage, and body together and awaken your astral self for 10 minutes (ends early if you are incapacitated or die).
Armor of the Spirit: +2 bonus to AC.
Astral Barrage: when you use Extra Attack to attack twice, you can instead attack three times if all the attacks are made with the astral arms.
Awakened Astral Self.desc_short: Spend 5 ki points to summon the arms, visage, and body together and awaken your astral self for 10 minutes (ends early if you are incapacitated or die).

Draconic Disciple.title: Draconic Disciple
Draconic Disciple.desc_long:
Draconic Presence: if you fail a Charisma (Intimidation) or Charisma (Persuasion) check, you can use your reaction to reroll it. Once this turns a failure into a success, you can't use it again until a long rest.
Draconic Strike: when you damage a target with an unarmed strike, you can change the damage type to acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison.
Tongue of Dragons: you learn to speak, read, and write Draconic or one other language of your choice.

Breath of the Dragon.title: Breath of the Dragon
Breath of the Dragon.desc_long: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one attack with an exhalation in a 20-foot cone or a 30-foot line 5 feet wide. Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity save against your ki save DC, taking damage equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die on a failure, or half on a success (three rolls at 11th level). You can use this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses on a long rest, and when you have none left you can spend 2 ki points to use it again.

Wings Unfurled.title: Wings Unfurled
Wings Unfurled.desc_long: When you use Step of the Wind, you can unfurl spectral draconic wings that vanish at the end of your turn. While they exist, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus.

Aspect of the Wyrm.title: Aspect of the Wyrm
Aspect of the Wyrm.desc_long:
Create an aura of draconic power in a 10-foot radius for 1 minute, gaining one of two effects.
Frightful Presence: when you create the aura and as a bonus action on later turns, choose a creature in it; it must succeed on a Wisdom save against your ki save DC or be frightened of you for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.
Resistance: choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison; you and your allies in the aura resist that damage. After using this once, you can't create it again until a long rest unless you spend 3 ki points.

Ascendant Aspect.title: Ascendant Aspect
Ascendant Aspect.desc_long:
Augment Breath: when you use Breath of the Dragon, you can spend 1 ki point to make it a 60-foot cone or 90-foot line 5 feet wide, dealing four rolls of your Martial Arts die on a failed save, or half on a success.
Blindsight: you gain blindsight out to 10 feet. Explosive Fury: when you activate Aspect of the Wyrm, choose any number of creatures you can see in the aura; each must succeed on a Dexterity save against your ki save DC or take 3d10 acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage (your choice).

Bonus Proficiencies.title: Bonus Proficiencies
Bonus Proficiencies.desc_long: You gain proficiency in Performance and with brewer's supplies if you don't already have them.

Drunken Technique.title: Drunken Technique
Drunken Technique.desc_long: Whenever you use Flurry of Blows, you gain the benefit of the Disengage action, and your walking speed increases by 10 feet until the end of the current turn.

Tipsy Sway.title: Tipsy Sway
Tipsy Sway.desc_long:
Leap to Your Feet: when prone, you stand up by spending 5 feet of movement instead of half your speed.
Redirect Attack: when a creature misses you with a melee attack roll, you can spend 1 ki point as a reaction to make that attack hit a different creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of you.

Drunkard's Luck.title: Drunkard's Luck
Drunkard's Luck.desc_long: When you make an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw and have disadvantage, you can spend 2 ki points to cancel the disadvantage for that roll.

Intoxicated Frenzy.title: Intoxicated Frenzy
Intoxicated Frenzy.desc_long: When you use Flurry of Blows, you can make up to three additional attacks with it (a total of five Flurry attacks), provided each one targets a different creature this turn.

Disciple of the Elements.title: Disciple of the Elements
Disciple of the Elements.desc_long: You learn magical elemental disciplines that cost ki points each time you use them. You know Elemental Attunement plus one other discipline of your choice, and learn one more at 6th, 11th, and 17th level. Whenever you learn a new discipline, you can also replace one you know. Disciplines that cast spells use the spell's normal casting time and rules, but need no material components.

Path of the Kensei.title: Path of the Kensei
Path of the Kensei.desc_long:
Kensei Weapons: choose one melee and one ranged weapon type, each any simple or martial weapon without the heavy or special property (the longbow is also allowed). You gain proficiency with them, and they count as monk weapons for you. You choose another weapon type at 6th, 11th, and 17th level.
Agile Parry: if you make an unarmed strike as part of the Attack action while holding a kensei melee weapon, you gain +2 AC until the start of your next turn.
Kensei's Shot: as a bonus action, until the end of the turn, ranged hits with a kensei weapon deal an extra 1d4 damage of the weapon's type.
Way of the Brush: you gain proficiency with calligrapher's supplies or painter's supplies.
Path of the Kensei.desc_short: Kensei Weapons, Agile Parry, Kensei's Shot, & Way of the Brush.

One with the Blade.title: One with the Blade
One with the Blade.desc_long:
Magic Kensei Weapons: attacks with your kensei weapons count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.
Deft Strike: when you hit with a kensei weapon, you can spend 1 ki point to deal extra damage equal to your Martial Arts die, once per turn.

Sharpen the Blade.title: Sharpen the Blade
Sharpen the Blade.desc_long: Spend up to 3 ki points to give a kensei weapon you touch a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the ki spent, for 1 minute or until you use this again. It has no effect on a magic weapon that already has a bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Unerring Accuracy.title: Unerring Accuracy
Unerring Accuracy.desc_long: If you miss with an attack roll using a monk weapon on your turn, you can reroll it. Once on each of your turns.

Touch of Death.title: Touch of Death
Touch of Death.desc_long: When you reduce a creature within 5 feet of you to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier + your monk level (minimum 1).

Hour of Reaping.title: Hour of Reaping
Hour of Reaping.duration: Until end of your next turn
Hour of Reaping.desc_long: As an action, each creature within 30 feet that can see you must succeed on a Wisdom save or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

Mastery of Death.title: Mastery of Death
Mastery of Death.desc_long: When you are reduced to 0 hit points, you can expend 1 ki point (no action required) to have 1 hit point instead.

Touch of the Long Death.title: Touch of the Long Death
Touch of the Long Death.desc_long: As an action, touch one creature within 5 feet and expend 1 to 10 ki points. The target makes a Constitution save, taking 2d10 necrotic damage per ki point spent on a failure, or half on a success.

Implements of Mercy.title: Implements of Mercy
Implements of Mercy.desc_long: You gain proficiency in Insight and Medicine and with the herbalism kit. You also gain a special mask you wear when using this subclass's features; choose its look.

Hands of Healing.title: Hands of Healing
Hands of Healing.desc_long: Spend 1 ki point to touch a creature and restore hit points equal to a roll of your Martial Arts die + your Wisdom modifier. When you use Flurry of Blows, you can replace one of the unarmed strikes with a use of this feature without spending the ki point.

Hands of Harm.title: Hands of Harm
Hands of Harm.desc_long: When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 1 ki point to deal extra necrotic damage equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die + your Wisdom modifier. Once per turn.

Physician's Touch.title: Physician's Touch
Physician's Touch.duration: Until end of your next turn (poison)
Physician's Touch.desc_long: When you use Hands of Healing on a creature, you can also end one disease or one of these conditions on it: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned, or stunned. When you use Hands of Harm on a creature, you can also subject it to the poisoned condition until the end of your next turn.

Flurry of Healing and Harm.title: Flurry of Healing and Harm
Flurry of Healing and Harm.desc_long: When you use Flurry of Blows, you can replace each of the unarmed strikes with a use of Hands of Healing, without spending ki for the healing. Also, when you make an unarmed strike with Flurry of Blows, you can use Hands of Harm with that strike without spending the ki point, though still only once per turn.

Hand of Ultimate Mercy.title: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
Hand of Ultimate Mercy.desc_long: Touch the corpse of a creature that died within the past 24 hours and expend 5 ki points. It returns to life with hit points equal to 4d10 + your Wisdom modifier. If it died while blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned, or stunned, those conditions are removed. Once per long rest.

Open Hand Technique.title: Open Hand Technique
Open Hand Technique.duration: Until end of your next turn (no reactions)
Open Hand Technique.desc_long: Whenever you hit a creature with an attack from Flurry of Blows, you can impose one effect: it must succeed on a Dexterity save or be knocked prone; it must make a Strength save or be pushed up to 15 feet away from you; or it can't take reactions until the end of your next turn.

Wholeness of Body.title: Wholeness of Body
Wholeness of Body.desc_long: As an action, you regain hit points equal to three times your monk level. Once per long rest.

Tranquility.title: Tranquility
Tranquility.duration: Until start of next long rest
Tranquility.desc_long: At the end of a long rest, you gain the effect of the Sanctuary spell that lasts until the start of your next long rest (it can end early as normal). The spell's save DC equals 8 + your Wisdom modifier + your proficiency bonus.

Quivering Palm.title: Quivering Palm
Quivering Palm.desc_long: When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 3 ki points to start imperceptible vibrations that last a number of days equal to your monk level and are harmless until you use your action to end them (you and the target must be on the same plane). The creature then makes a Constitution save: on a failure it is reduced to 0 hit points, on a success it takes 10d10 necrotic damage. Only one creature can be affected at a time, and you can end the vibrations harmlessly without an action.
Quivering Palm.desc_short: When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 3 ki points to start imperceptible vibrations within them. The creature then makes a Constitution save: on a failure it is reduced to 0 hit points, on a success it takes 10d10 necrotic damage.

Shadow Arts.title: Shadow Arts
Shadow Arts.desc_long: As an action, you can spend 2 ki points to cast Darkness, Darkvision, Pass without Trace, or Silence without material components. You also gain the Minor Illusion cantrip if you don't already know it.

Shadow Step.title: Shadow Step
Shadow Step.desc_long: While in dim light or darkness, you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness. You then have advantage on the first melee attack you make before the end of the turn.

Cloak of Shadows.title: Cloak of Shadows
Cloak of Shadows.duration: Until you attack, cast a spell, or enter bright light
Cloak of Shadows.desc_long: While in dim light or darkness, you can use your action to become invisible. You stay invisible until you make an attack, cast a spell, or enter an area of bright light.

Opportunist.title: Opportunist
Opportunist.desc_long: Whenever a creature within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack made by a creature other than you, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against it.

Radiant Sun Bolt.title: Radiant Sun Bolt
Radiant Sun Bolt.desc_long: You gain a ranged spell attack option for the Attack action with a range of 30 feet. You are proficient with it, add your Dexterity modifier to its attack and damage rolls, and it deals radiant damage with a die equal to your Martial Arts die (d4 at 3rd level). When you use it as part of the Attack action, you can spend 1 ki point to make the special attack twice as a bonus action. Once you have Extra Attack, it can be used for any of the attacks in the Attack action.
Radiant Sun Bolt.desc_short: You gain a ranged spell attack option for the Attack action with a range of 30 feet. You are proficient with it, add your Dexterity modifier to its attack and damage rolls, and it deals radiant damage with a die equal to your Martial Arts die.

Searing Arc Strike.title: Searing Arc Strike
Searing Arc Strike.desc_long: Immediately after you take the Attack action, you can spend 2 ki points to cast Burning Hands as a bonus action. Each additional ki point spent raises the spell's level by 1, up to a total ki spent (2 plus extra) equal to half your monk level.

Searing Sunburst.title: Searing Sunburst
Searing Sunburst.desc_long: Hurl an orb at a point within 150 feet that erupts in a 20-foot-radius sphere of radiant light. Each creature in it must succeed on a Constitution save or take 2d6 radiant damage (no save needed behind opaque total cover). Each ki point spent, up to 3, adds 2d6 damage.

Sun Shield.title: Sun Shield
Sun Shield.desc_long: You shed bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for another 30 feet, and you can extinguish or restore the light as a bonus action. If a creature hits you with a melee attack while it shines, you can use your reaction to deal radiant damage to it equal to 5 + your Wisdom modifier.

Channel Divinity: Nature's Wrath.title: Channel Divinity: Nature's Wrath
Channel Divinity: Nature's Wrath.desc_long: Spectral vines reach for a creature you can see within 10 feet. It must succeed on a Strength or Dexterity save (its choice) or be restrained. While restrained it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, and on a success it frees itself and the vines vanish.

Channel Divinity: Turn the Faithless.title: Channel Divinity: Turn the Faithless
Channel Divinity: Turn the Faithless.desc_long: Present your holy symbol. Each fey or fiend within 30 feet that can hear you makes a Wisdom save; on a failure it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage. A turned creature must try to move as far from you as it can, can't willingly move within 30 feet of you, can't take reactions, and can only Dash or try to escape an effect that stops it from moving (or Dodge if it has nowhere to go). If its true form is hidden by an illusion, shapechanging, or other effect, that form is revealed while it is turned.

Aura of Warding.title: Aura of Warding
Aura of Warding.desc_long: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet have resistance to damage from spells. The range becomes 30 feet at 18th level.

Undying Sentinel.title: Undying Sentinel
Undying Sentinel.desc_long: When you are reduced to 0 hit points and not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead, once per long rest. You also suffer none of the drawbacks of old age and can't be aged magically.

Elder Champion.title: Elder Champion
Elder Champion.desc_long: You transform into an ancient force of nature for 1 minute. At the start of each of your turns you regain 10 hit points; paladin spells with a casting time of 1 action can be cast as a bonus action; and enemies within 10 feet have disadvantage on saves against your paladin spells and Channel Divinity options. Once per long rest.

Channel Divinity: Conquering Presence.title: Channel Divinity: Conquering Presence
Channel Divinity: Conquering Presence.desc_long: Each creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it is frightened of you for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.

Channel Divinity: Guided Strike.title: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
Channel Divinity: Guided Strike.desc_long: When you make an attack roll, you can gain a +10 bonus to it. You decide after seeing the roll but before the DM says whether it hits.

Aura of Conquest.title: Aura of Conquest
Aura of Conquest.desc_long: While you aren't incapacitated, you emanate a menacing aura 10 feet in every direction (not through total cover). A creature frightened of you has its speed reduced to 0 while in the aura and takes psychic damage equal to half your paladin level if it starts its turn there. The range becomes 30 feet at 18th level.

Scornful Rebuke.title: Scornful Rebuke
Scornful Rebuke.desc_long: Whenever a creature hits you with an attack, it takes psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), as long as you aren't incapacitated.

Invincible Conqueror.title: Invincible Conqueror
Invincible Conqueror.desc_long: You become an avatar of conquest for 1 minute: resistance to all damage, one additional attack when you take the Attack action, and melee weapon attacks that crit on a 19 or 20. Once per long rest.

Channel Divinity: Champion Challenge.title: Channel Divinity: Champion Challenge
Channel Divinity: Champion Challenge.duration: Until you are incapacitated or the creature is over 30 ft. away
Channel Divinity: Champion Challenge.desc_long: Each creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it can't willingly move more than 30 feet away from you. The effect ends on a creature if you are incapacitated or die, or if it is more than 30 feet from you.

Channel Divinity: Turn the Tide.title: Channel Divinity: Turn the Tide
Channel Divinity: Turn the Tide.desc_long: Each creature of your choice within 30 feet that can hear you and has no more than half its hit points regains hit points equal to 1d6 + your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

Divine Allegiance.title: Divine Allegiance
Divine Allegiance.desc_long: When a creature within 5 feet takes damage, you can use your reaction to take that damage instead. This damage to you can't be reduced or prevented in any way.

Unyielding Saint.title: Unyielding Saint
Unyielding Saint.desc_long: You have advantage on saving throws to avoid becoming paralyzed or stunned.

Exalted Champion.title: Exalted Champion
Exalted Champion.desc_long: For 1 hour: you resist bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons; your allies within 30 feet have advantage on death saving throws; and you and your allies within 30 feet have advantage on Wisdom saves. It ends early if you are incapacitated or die. Once per long rest.

Channel Divinity: Sacred Weapon.title: Channel Divinity: Sacred Weapon
Channel Divinity: Sacred Weapon.desc_long: Imbue a weapon you are holding with positive energy for 1 minute. You add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls with it (minimum +1). It emits bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light 20 feet beyond, and becomes magical if it isn't already. You can end the effect on your turn as part of any other action; it also ends if you stop holding the weapon or fall unconscious.

Channel Divinity: Turn the Unholy.title: Channel Divinity: Turn the Unholy
Channel Divinity: Turn the Unholy.desc_long: Present your holy symbol. Each fiend or undead within 30 feet that can see or hear you makes a Wisdom save; on a failure it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage. A turned creature must try to move as far from you as it can, can't willingly move within 30 feet of you, can't take reactions, and can only Dash or try to escape an effect that stops it from moving (or Dodge if it has nowhere to go).

Aura of Devotion.title: Aura of Devotion
Aura of Devotion.desc_long: While you are conscious, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet can't be charmed. The range becomes 30 feet at 18th level.

Purity of Spirit.title: Purity of Spirit
Purity of Spirit.desc_long: You are always under the effects of the Protection from Evil and Good spell.

Holy Nimbus.title: Holy Nimbus
Holy Nimbus.desc_long: Emanate an aura of sunlight for 1 minute: bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light 30 feet beyond. An enemy that starts its turn in the bright light takes 10 radiant damage. You also have advantage on saves against spells cast by fiends or undead. Once per long rest.

Channel Divinity: Peerless Athlete.title: Channel Divinity: Peerless Athlete
Channel Divinity: Peerless Athlete.desc_long: For 10 minutes you have advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks, can carry, push, drag, and lift twice as much weight, and your long and high jumps are 10 feet farther (the extra distance costs movement as normal).

Channel Divinity: Inspiring Smite.title: Channel Divinity: Inspiring Smite
Channel Divinity: Inspiring Smite.desc_long: Immediately after dealing damage with Divine Smite, you can distribute temporary hit points totaling 2d8 + your paladin level among creatures of your choice within 30 feet (you can be one), divided however you like.

Aura of Alacrity.title: Aura of Alacrity
Aura of Alacrity.desc_long: Your walking speed increases by 10 feet. While you aren't incapacitated, any ally who starts their turn within 5 feet of you gains +10 feet of walking speed until the end of that turn. The range becomes 10 feet at 18th level.

Glorious Defense.title: Glorious Defense
Glorious Defense.desc_long: When you or a creature you can see within 10 feet is hit by an attack roll, you can grant the target a bonus to AC against that attack equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1), potentially causing a miss. If the attack misses, you can make one weapon attack against the attacker as part of this reaction if it is within your weapon's range. You can do this a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier.

Living Legend.title: Living Legend
Living Legend.desc_long: For 1 minute: advantage on all Charisma checks; once on each of your turns, you can turn a missed weapon attack into a hit; and if you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to reroll it and must use the new roll. Once per long rest, unless you expend a 5th-level spell slot to use it again.

Channel Divinity: Emissary of Peace.title: Channel Divinity: Emissary of Peace
Channel Divinity: Emissary of Peace.desc_long: You gain a +5 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks for 10 minutes.

Channel Divinity: Rebuke the Violent.title: Channel Divinity: Rebuke the Violent
Channel Divinity: Rebuke the Violent.desc_long: Immediately after an attacker within 30 feet deals damage with an attack against a creature other than you, you can force it to make a Wisdom save. On a failure it takes radiant damage equal to the damage it just dealt, or half as much on a success.

Aura of the Guardian.title: Aura of the Guardian
Aura of the Guardian.desc_long: When a creature within 10 feet takes damage, you can use your reaction to take that damage instead. Other effects accompanying the damage aren't transferred, and this damage can't be reduced in any way. The range becomes 30 feet at 18th level.

Protective Spirit.title: Protective Spirit
Protective Spirit.desc_long: If you end your turn in combat with fewer than half your hit points and aren't incapacitated, you regain hit points equal to 1d6 + half your paladin level.

Emissary of Redemption.title: Emissary of Redemption
Emissary of Redemption.desc_long: You have resistance to all damage dealt by other creatures (attacks, spells, and other effects), and whenever a creature hits you with an attack, it takes radiant damage equal to half the damage you take. If you attack a creature, cast a spell on it, or deal damage to it by any other means, neither benefit works against that creature until you finish a long rest.

Channel Divinity: Abjure Enemy.title: Channel Divinity: Abjure Enemy
Channel Divinity: Abjure Enemy.desc_long: Present your holy symbol and choose a creature you can see within 60 feet. It makes a Wisdom save (fiends and undead have disadvantage; creatures immune to being frightened are unaffected). On a failure it is frightened for 1 minute or until it takes damage, with a speed of 0 and no speed bonuses. On a success its speed is halved for 1 minute or until it takes damage.

Channel Divinity: Vow of Enmity.title: Channel Divinity: Vow of Enmity
Channel Divinity: Vow of Enmity.desc_long: Utter a vow against a creature you can see within 10 feet. You have advantage on attack rolls against it for 1 minute or until it drops to 0 hit points or falls unconscious.

Relentless Avenger.title: Relentless Avenger
Relentless Avenger.desc_long: When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, you can move up to half your speed immediately after, as part of the same reaction. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

Soul of Vengeance.title: Soul of Vengeance
Soul of Vengeance.desc_long: When a creature under your Vow of Enmity makes an attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it if it is within range.

Avenging Angel.title: Avenging Angel
Avenging Angel.desc_long: For 1 hour you sprout wings granting a 60-foot flying speed and emanate a 30-foot aura of menace. The first time an enemy enters the aura or starts its turn there during a battle, it must succeed on a Wisdom save or be frightened of you for 1 minute or until it takes damage, and attack rolls against it have advantage. Once per long rest.

Channel Divinity: Watcher's Will.title: Channel Divinity: Watcher's Will
Channel Divinity: Watcher's Will.desc_long: Choose up to your Charisma modifier (minimum one) creatures you can see within 30 feet. For 1 minute, you and the chosen creatures have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

Channel Divinity: Abjure the Extraplanar.title: Channel Divinity: Abjure the Extraplanar
Channel Divinity: Abjure the Extraplanar.desc_long: Present your holy symbol. Each aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend within 30 feet that can hear you makes a Wisdom save; on a failure it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage. A turned creature must try to move as far from you as it can, can't willingly end its move within 30 feet of you, and can only Dash or try to escape an effect that stops it from moving (or Dodge if it has nowhere to go).

Aura of the Sentinel.title: Aura of the Sentinel
Aura of the Sentinel.desc_long: While you aren't incapacitated, when you and any creatures of your choice within 10 feet roll initiative, you all gain a bonus to initiative equal to your proficiency bonus. The range becomes 30 feet at 18th level.

Vigilant Rebuke.title: Vigilant Rebuke
Vigilant Rebuke.desc_long: When you or a creature you can see within 30 feet succeeds on an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma save, you can use your reaction to deal 2d8 + your Charisma modifier force damage to the creature that forced the save.

Mortal Bulwark.title: Mortal Bulwark
Mortal Bulwark.desc_long: For 1 minute: truesight out to 120 feet; advantage on attack rolls against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, and fiends; and when you hit a creature and deal damage, you can force a Charisma save against your spell save DC. On a failure it is banished to its native plane if it isn't there; on a success it can't be banished by this feature for 24 hours. Once per long rest, unless you expend a 5th-level spell slot to use it again.

Channel Divinity: Control Undead.title: Channel Divinity: Control Undead
Channel Divinity: Control Undead.desc_long: Target one undead creature you can see within 30 feet. It makes a Wisdom save; on a failure it must obey your commands for 24 hours or until you use this option again. An undead whose challenge rating is equal to or higher than your paladin level is immune.

Channel Divinity: Dreadful Aspect.title: Channel Divinity: Dreadful Aspect
Channel Divinity: Dreadful Aspect.desc_long: Each creature of your choice within 30 feet that can see you makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it is frightened of you for 1 minute. If a creature frightened this way ends its turn more than 30 feet from you, it can make another Wisdom save to end the effect on itself.

Aura of Hate.title: Aura of Hate
Aura of Hate.desc_long: You, and any fiends and undead within 10 feet of you, gain a bonus to melee weapon damage rolls equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1). A creature can benefit from this feature from only one paladin at a time. The range becomes 30 feet at 18th level.

Supernatural Resistance.title: Supernatural Resistance
Supernatural Resistance.desc_long: You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons.

Dread Lord.title: Dread Lord
Dread Lord.desc_long: Surround yourself with an aura of gloom for 1 minute that reduces bright light in a 30-foot radius to dim light. An enemy frightened by you that starts its turn in the aura takes 4d10 psychic damage. You and creatures of your choice in the aura are draped in deeper shadow, and creatures that rely on sight have disadvantage on attack rolls against them. While the aura lasts, you can use a bonus action to have the shadows attack one creature: make a melee spell attack, dealing 3d10 + your Charisma modifier necrotic damage on a hit. Once per long rest.

Ranger's Companion.title: Ranger's Companion
Ranger's Companion.desc_long: You gain a beast companion of Medium size or smaller with a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower. Add your proficiency bonus to its AC, attack rolls, damage rolls, saving throws, and proficient skills. Its hit point maximum is its normal maximum or four times your ranger level, whichever is higher. It acts on your initiative. You can verbally command it to move without using an action, or use your action to command it to Attack, Dash, Disengage, or Help. Otherwise, it takes the Dodge action. Once you gain Extra Attack, you can make one weapon attack when commanding it to Attack. If it dies, you can bond with another nonhostile beast over 8 hours.

Primal Companion.title: Primal Companion
Primal Companion.desc_long: Optional feature replacing Ranger's Companion. You magically summon a Beast of the Land, Beast of the Sea, or Beast of the Sky. It uses your proficiency bonus in its statistics and appears in an appropriate animal form. It acts during your turn and takes the Dodge action unless you use a bonus action to command it otherwise. You can also sacrifice one of your attacks when taking the Attack action to command it to Attack. If you are incapacitated, it can take any action. If it died within the last hour, you can touch it as an action and expend a spell slot of 1st level or higher to revive it with all its hit points after 1 minute. You can summon a different beast after a long rest.

Exceptional Training.title: Exceptional Training
Exceptional Training.desc_long: When your beast companion doesn't attack on its turn, you can use a bonus action to command it to Dash, Disengage, or Help. Additionally, its attacks count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

Bestial Fury.title: Bestial Fury
Bestial Fury.desc_long: When you command your beast companion to take the Attack action, it can make two attacks or use its Multiattack action if it has one.

Share Spells.title: Share Spells
Share Spells.desc_long: When you cast a spell that targets yourself, you can also affect your beast companion with that spell if it is within 30 feet of you.

Draconic Gift.title: Draconic Gift
Draconic Gift.desc_long: At 3rd level, your bond with your drake grants you two benefits. You learn the Thaumaturgy cantrip, which counts as a ranger spell for you. You also learn to speak, read, and write Draconic or one other language of your choice.

Drake Companion.title: Drake Companion
Drake Companion.duration: Until reduced to 0 HP, resummoned, or you die
Drake Companion.desc_long: At 3rd level, you can magically summon your drake into an unoccupied space within 30 feet. It is friendly to you and your companions and obeys your commands. Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison as its Draconic Essence damage type whenever you summon it. It shares your initiative and takes its turn immediately after yours. It can move and use its reaction independently, but takes the Dodge action unless you use a bonus action to command it to take another action. If you are incapacitated, it can take any action. The drake disappears if reduced to 0 hit points, if summoned again, or if you die. You can summon it again after a long rest, or by expending a spell slot of 1st level or higher.
Drake Companion.desc_short: you can magically summon your drake into an unoccupied space within 30 feet. It is friendly to you and your companions and obeys your commands. Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison as its Draconic Essence damage type whenever you summon it. It shares your initiative and takes its turn immediately after yours.

Bond of Fang and Scale.title: Bond of Fang and Scale
Bond of Fang and Scale.desc_long:
When summoned, your drake gains wings and a flying speed equal to its walking speed. While it is summoned, you and the drake gain these benefits:
- Drake Mount: The drake becomes Medium and can serve as your mount if you are Medium or smaller. It cannot fly while you ride it.
- Magic Fang: Its Bite attack deals an additional 1d6 damage of its Draconic Essence type.
- Resistance: You gain resistance to the damage type chosen for its Draconic Essence.

Drake's Breath.title: Drake's Breath
Drake's Breath.desc_long: At 11th level, you or your drake can exhale a 30-foot cone of damaging breath. Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage. Each creature in the cone makes a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 8d6 damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The damage increases to 10d6 at 15th level. You can use this feature once per long rest, unless you expend a spell slot of 3rd level or higher to use it again.

Perfected Bond.title: Perfected Bond
Perfected Bond.desc_long:
At 15th level, your drake bond reaches its peak. While your drake is summoned:
- Empowered Bite: Its Bite attack deals an additional 1d6 damage of its Draconic Essence type, for a total of 2d6 extra damage.
- Large Drake: It becomes Large and can fly while you ride it.
- Reflexive Resistance: When you or your drake takes damage while within 30 feet of each other, you can use your reaction to grant yourself or the drake resistance to that instance of damage. You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus and regain all uses after a long rest.

Dreadful Strikes.title: Dreadful Strikes
Dreadful Strikes.desc_long: At 3rd level, when you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an additional 1d4 psychic damage to it. A creature can take this extra damage only once per turn. The extra damage increases to 1d6 at 11th level.

Otherworldly Glamour.title: Otherworldly Glamour
Otherworldly Glamour.desc_long: At 3rd level, you gain a bonus to all Charisma checks equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1). You also gain proficiency in one of the following skills: Deception, Performance, or Persuasion.

Beguiling Twist.title: Beguiling Twist
Beguiling Twist.desc_long: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. Whenever you or a creature you can see within 120 feet succeeds on a saving throw against being charmed or frightened, you can use your reaction to force a different creature you can see within 120 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, you choose whether it is charmed or frightened by you for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

Fey Reinforcements.title: Fey Reinforcements
Fey Reinforcements.desc_long: At 11th level, you learn Summon Fey. It counts as a ranger spell for you and doesn't count against your spells known. You can cast it without a material component and once without expending a spell slot, regaining this free use after a long rest. Whenever you begin casting it, you can choose to remove its concentration requirement. If you do, its duration becomes 1 minute for that casting.

Misty Wanderer.title: Misty Wanderer
Misty Wanderer.desc_long: At 15th level, you can cast Misty Step without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once). You regain all expended uses after a long rest. Whenever you cast Misty Step, you can also teleport one willing creature you can see within 5 feet of you to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of your destination.

Dread Ambusher.title: Dread Ambusher
Dread Ambusher.duration: Until the end of your first turn
Dread Ambusher.desc_long: At 3rd level, you gain a bonus to initiative rolls equal to your Wisdom modifier. At the start of your first turn in each combat, your walking speed increases by 10 feet until the end of that turn. If you take the Attack action during that turn, you can make one additional weapon attack as part of it. If that attack hits, it deals an extra 1d8 damage of the weapon's damage type.

Umbral Sight.title: Umbral Sight
Umbral Sight.desc_long: At 3rd level, you gain darkvision out to 60 feet. If you already have darkvision, its range increases by 30 feet. While in darkness, you are invisible to creatures that rely on darkvision to see you in that darkness.

Iron Mind.title: Iron Mind
Iron Mind.desc_long: At 7th level, you gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws. If you already have this proficiency, you instead gain proficiency in either Intelligence or Charisma saving throws (your choice).

Stalker's Flurry.title: Stalker's Flurry
Stalker's Flurry.desc_long: At 11th level, once on each of your turns when you miss with a weapon attack, you can make another weapon attack as part of the same action.

Shadowy Dodge.title: Shadowy Dodge
Shadowy Dodge.duration: Until the attack roll is resolved
Shadowy Dodge.desc_long: At 15th level, when a creature makes an attack roll against you and doesn't have advantage on the roll, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on that attack roll. You must use this feature before you know the outcome of the roll.

Detect Portal.title: Detect Portal
Detect Portal.desc_long: At 3rd level, you can magically sense the presence of a planar portal. As an action, you detect the distance and direction to the closest planar portal within 1 mile. You regain the ability to use this feature after a short or long rest.

Planar Warrior.title: Planar Warrior
Planar Warrior.duration: Until the end of the current turn
Planar Warrior.desc_long: At 3rd level, as a bonus action, choose one creature you can see within 30 feet. The next time you hit that creature with a weapon attack on the same turn, all damage dealt by the attack becomes force damage, and it takes an additional 1d8 force damage. This extra damage increases to 2d8 at 11th level.

Ethereal Step.title: Ethereal Step
Ethereal Step.duration: Until the end of the current turn
Ethereal Step.desc_long: At 7th level, you can cast Etherealness as a bonus action without expending a spell slot. The spell ends at the end of the current turn. You regain the ability to use this feature after a short or long rest.

Distant Strike.title: Distant Strike
Distant Strike.desc_long: At 11th level, when you take the Attack action, you can teleport up to 10 feet to an unoccupied space you can see before each attack. If you attack at least two different creatures with that action, you can make one additional attack against a third creature with the same action.

Spectral Defense.title: Spectral Defense
Spectral Defense.duration: Until the end of the current turn
Spectral Defense.desc_long: At 15th level, when you take damage from an attack, you can use your reaction to gain resistance to all damage dealt by that attack for the current turn.

Hunter's Prey.title: Hunter's Prey
Hunter's Prey.desc_long:
At 3rd level, choose one of the following features:
- Colossus Slayer: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack and it is below its hit point maximum, it takes an extra 1d8 damage.
- Giant Killer: When a Large or larger creature within 5 feet hits or misses you with an attack, you can use your reaction to immediately make an attack against it, provided you can see it.
- Horde Breaker: Once on each of your turns when you make a weapon attack, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature within 5 feet of the original target and within your weapon's range.

Defensive Tactics.title: Defensive Tactics
Defensive Tactics.desc_long:
At 7th level, choose one of the following features:
- Escape the Horde: Opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage.
- Multiattack Defense: When a creature hits you with an attack, you gain a +4 bonus to AC against all subsequent attacks made by that creature for the rest of the turn.
- Steel Will: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

Multiattack.title: Multiattack
Multiattack.desc_long:
At 11th level, choose one of the following features:
- Volley: Use your action to make a separate ranged weapon attack against any number of creatures within 10 feet of a point you can see within your weapon's range. You need ammunition for each target.
- Whirlwind Attack: Use your action to make a separate melee attack against any number of creatures within 5 feet of you.

Superior Hunter's Defense.title: Superior Hunter's Defense
Superior Hunter's Defense.action: Reaction (Stand Against the Tide / Uncanny Dodge)
Superior Hunter's Defense.desc_long:
At 15th level, choose one of the following features:
- Evasion: When an effect allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take half damage, you instead take no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.
- Stand Against the Tide: When a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to force it to repeat the attack against another creature of your choice other than itself.
- Uncanny Dodge: When an attacker you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.

Hunter's Sense.title: Hunter's Sense
Hunter's Sense.desc_long: At 3rd level, as an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet. You learn whether it has any damage immunities, resistances, or vulnerabilities and what they are. If it is hidden from divination magic, you instead sense that it has none. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once), regaining all uses after a long rest.

Slayer's Prey.title: Slayer's Prey
Slayer's Prey.desc_long: At 3rd level, as a bonus action, designate one creature you can see within 60 feet as your prey. The first time each turn you hit that creature with a weapon attack, it takes an extra 1d6 damage from the weapon. The effect lasts until you finish a short or long rest, or until you designate a different creature.

Supernatural Defense.title: Supernatural Defense
Supernatural Defense.desc_long: At 7th level, whenever the target of your Slayer's Prey forces you to make a saving throw, or whenever you make an ability check to escape that creature's grapple, add 1d6 to your roll.

Magic-User's Nemesis.title: Magic-User's Nemesis
Magic-User's Nemesis.desc_long: At 11th level, when you see a creature casting a spell or teleporting within 60 feet, you can use your reaction to attempt to foil it. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or its spell or teleportation fails and is wasted. You regain the ability to use this feature after a short or long rest.

Slayer's Counter.title: Slayer's Counter
Slayer's Counter.desc_long: At 15th level, when the target of your Slayer's Prey forces you to make a saving throw, you can use your reaction to make one weapon attack against it immediately before making the save. If the attack hits, your saving throw automatically succeeds in addition to the attack's normal effects.

Gathered Swarm.title: Gathered Swarm
Gathered Swarm.desc_long:
At 3rd level, intangible nature spirits bond with you and remain in your space while you are alive. You determine their appearance. Once on each of your turns, immediately after hitting a creature with an attack, you can have the swarm do one of the following:
- Deal 1d6 piercing damage to the target.
- Force the target to make a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or be moved up to 15 feet horizontally in a direction of your choice.
- Move yourself 5 feet horizontally in a direction of your choice.

Swarmkeeper Magic.title: Swarmkeeper Magic
Swarmkeeper Magic.desc_long: At 3rd level, you learn the Mage Hand cantrip if you don't already know it. When cast, the hand takes the form of your nature spirits. You also learn additional spells at the levels listed in the Swarmkeeper Spells table. These spells count as ranger spells but don't count against your number of ranger spells known.

Writhing Tide.title: Writhing Tide
Writhing Tide.desc_long: At 7th level, you can condense part of your swarm to lift you. As a bonus action, you gain a flying speed of 10 feet and can hover. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until you are incapacitated. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus and regain all expended uses after a long rest.

Mighty Swarm.title: Mighty Swarm
Mighty Swarm.desc_long:
At 11th level, your Gathered Swarm improves:
- Its piercing damage increases to 1d8.
- When a creature fails its saving throw against being moved by your swarm, you can also knock it prone.
- When your swarm moves you, it gives you half cover until the start of your next turn.

Swarming Dispersal.title: Swarming Dispersal
Swarming Dispersal.desc_long: At 15th level, when you take damage, you can use your reaction to gain resistance to that damage. You then vanish into your swarm and teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet, where you reappear with the swarm. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus and regain all expended uses after a long rest.

Spellcasting.title: Spellcasting
Spellcasting.desc_long:
You gain the ability to cast spells. You learn three wizard cantrips: Mage Hand and two other cantrips of your choice from the wizard spell list. You learn another wizard cantrip of your choice at 10th level.
You know three 1st-level wizard spells of your choice, two of which must be enchantment or illusion spells. The Spells Known column of the Arcane Trickster Spellcasting table determines when you learn additional spells. Each spell must be of a level for which you have spell slots and must be an enchantment or illusion spell, except spells learned at 8th, 14th, and 20th level, which can come from any school of magic. Whenever you gain a rogue level, you can replace one wizard spell you know with another spell from the wizard spell list, following the same school restrictions. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability. Your spell save DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier. Your spell attack modifier equals your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier. You regain all expended spell slots when you finish a long rest.
Spellcasting.desc_short: You gain the ability to cast spells.

Mage Hand Legerdemain.title: Mage Hand Legerdemain
Mage Hand Legerdemain.desc_long:
When you cast Mage Hand, you can make the spectral hand invisible and perform additional tasks with it:
- You can stow one object the hand is holding in a container worn or carried by another creature.
- You can retrieve an object from a container worn or carried by another creature.
- You can use thieves' tools to pick locks and disarm traps at range.
You can perform one of these tasks without being noticed by a creature if you succeed on a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check contested by its Wisdom (Perception) check.
You can use the bonus action granted by Cunning Action to control the hand.
Mage Hand Legerdemain.desc_short: When you cast Mage Hand, you can make the spectral hand invisible and perform additional tasks with it.

Magical Ambush.title: Magical Ambush
Magical Ambush.desc_long: Starting at 9th level, if you are hidden from a creature when you cast a spell on it, that creature has disadvantage on any saving throw it makes against the spell during that turn.

Versatile Trickster.title: Versatile Trickster
Versatile Trickster.duration: Until the end of the turn
Versatile Trickster.desc_long: At 13th level, you gain the ability to distract targets with your Mage Hand. As a bonus action on your turn, you can designate a creature within 5 feet of the spectral hand created by the spell. Doing so gives you advantage on attack rolls against that creature until the end of the turn.

Spell Thief.title: Spell Thief
Spell Thief.desc_long: You gain the ability to magically steal the knowledge of how to cast a spell from another spellcaster. Immediately after a creature casts a spell that targets you or includes you in its area of effect, you can use your reaction to force the creature to make a saving throw using its spellcasting ability modifier. The DC equals your spell save DC. On a failed save, you negate the spell's effect against you and steal knowledge of the spell if it is at least 1st level and of a level you can cast. The spell does not need to be a wizard spell. For the next 8 hours, you know the spell and can cast it using your spell slots. The creature cannot cast that spell until the 8 hours have passed. Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.
Spell Thief.desc_short: You gain the ability to magically steal the knowledge of how to cast a spell from another spellcaster. Immediately after a creature casts a spell that targets you or includes you in its area of effect, you can use your reaction to force the creature to make a saving throw using its spellcasting ability modifier. The DC equals your spell save DC.

Bonus Proficiencies.title: Bonus Proficiencies
Bonus Proficiencies.desc_long: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with the disguise kit and the poisoner's kit.

Assassinate.title: Assassinate
Assassinate.desc_long: Starting at 3rd level, you are at your deadliest when you get the drop on your enemies. You have advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn in the combat yet. In addition, any hit you score against a creature that is surprised is a critical hit.

Infiltration Expertise.title: Infiltration Expertise
Infiltration Expertise.duration: Until the identity is abandoned or exposed
Infiltration Expertise.desc_long: Starting at 9th level, you can unfailingly create false identities for yourself. You must spend seven days and 25 gp to establish the history, profession, and affiliations for an identity. You cannot establish an identity that belongs to someone else. Thereafter, if you adopt the new identity as a disguise, other creatures believe you to be that person until given an obvious reason not to.

Impostor.title: Impostor
Impostor.desc_long: At 13th level, you gain the ability to unerringly mimic another person's speech, writing, and behavior. You must spend at least three hours studying these three components of the person's behavior, listening to speech, examining handwriting, and observing mannerisms. Your ruse is indiscernible to the casual observer. If a wary creature suspects something is amiss, you have advantage on any Charisma (Deception) check you make to avoid detection.

Death Strike.title: Death Strike
Death Strike.desc_long: Starting at 17th level, you become a master of instant death. When you attack and hit a creature that is surprised, it must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier + your proficiency bonus). On a failed save, double the damage of your attack against the creature.

Ear for Deceit.title: Ear for Deceit
Ear for Deceit.desc_long: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you develop a keen ear for picking out lies. Whenever you make a Wisdom (Insight) check to determine whether a creature is lying, treat a roll of 7 or lower on the d20 as an 8.

Eye for Detail.title: Eye for Detail
Eye for Detail.desc_long: Starting at 3rd level, you can use a bonus action to make a Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a hidden creature or object, or to make an Intelligence (Investigation) check to uncover or decipher clues.

Insightful Fighting.title: Insightful Fighting
Insightful Fighting.duration: 1 minute or until you use it against a different target
Insightful Fighting.desc_long: At 3rd level, you gain the ability to decipher an opponent's tactics and develop a counter to them. As a bonus action, you make a Wisdom (Insight) check against a creature you can see that isn't incapacitated, contested by the target's Charisma (Deception) check. If you succeed, you can use your Sneak Attack against that target even if you don't have advantage on the attack roll, but not if you have disadvantage on it. This benefit lasts for 1 minute or until you successfully use this feature against a different target.

Steady Eye.title: Steady Eye
Steady Eye.desc_long: At 9th level, you gain advantage on any Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) check if you move no more than half your speed on the same turn.

Unerring Eye.title: Unerring Eye
Unerring Eye.desc_long: At 13th level, your senses are almost impossible to foil. As an action, you sense the presence of illusions, shapechangers not in their original form, and other magic designed to deceive the senses within 30 feet of you, provided you aren't blinded or deafened. You sense that an effect is attempting to trick you, but you gain no insight into what is hidden or into its true nature. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Eye for Weakness.title: Eye for Weakness
Eye for Weakness.desc_long: At 17th level, you learn to exploit a creature's weaknesses by carefully studying its tactics and movement. While your Insightful Fighting feature applies to a creature, your Sneak Attack damage against that creature increases by 3d6.

Master of Intrigue.title: Master of Intrigue
Master of Intrigue.desc_long: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with the disguise kit, the forgery kit, and one gaming set of your choice. You also learn two languages of your choice. Additionally, you can unerringly mimic the speech patterns and accent of a creature that you hear speak for at least 1 minute, enabling you to pass yourself off as a native speaker of a particular land, provided that you know the language.

Master of Tactics.title: Master of Tactics
Master of Tactics.desc_long: Starting at 3rd level, you can use the Help action as a bonus action. Additionally, when you use the Help action to aid an ally in attacking a creature, the target of that attack can be within 30 feet of you, rather than 5 feet of you, if the target can see or hear you.

Insightful Manipulator.title: Insightful Manipulator
Insightful Manipulator.desc_long:
Starting at 9th level, if you spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with another creature outside combat, you can learn certain information about its capabilities compared to your own. The DM tells you if the creature is your equal, superior, or inferior in regard to two of the following characteristics of your choice:
Intelligence score, Wisdom score, Charisma score, or Class levels (if any)
At the DM's option, you might also realize you know a piece of the creature's history or one of its personality traits, if it has any.

Misdirection.title: Misdirection
Misdirection.desc_long: Beginning at 13th level, you can sometimes cause another creature to suffer an attack meant for you. When you are targeted by an attack while a creature within 5 feet of you is granting you cover against that attack, you can use your reaction to have the attack target that creature instead of you.

Soul of Deceit.title: Soul of Deceit
Soul of Deceit.desc_long: Starting at 17th level, your thoughts can't be read by telepathy or other means, unless you allow it. You can present false thoughts by making a Charisma (Deception) check contested by the mind reader's Wisdom (Insight) check. Additionally, no matter what you say, magic that would determine if you are telling the truth indicates you are being truthful if you so choose, and you can't be compelled to tell the truth by magic.

Whispers of the Dead.title: Whispers of the Dead
Whispers of the Dead.duration: Until you use this feature to choose a different proficiency
Whispers of the Dead.desc_long: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, echoes of those who have died cling to you. Whenever you finish a short or long rest, you can gain one skill or tool proficiency of your choice, as a ghostly presence shares its knowledge with you. You lose this proficiency when you use this feature to choose a different proficiency that you lack.

Wails from the Grave.title: Wails from the Grave
Wails from the Grave.desc_long: At 3rd level, as you nudge someone closer to the grave, you can channel the power of death to harm someone else as well. Immediately after you deal your Sneak Attack damage to a creature on your turn, you can target a second creature that you can see within 30 feet of the first creature. Roll half the number of Sneak Attack dice for your level (round up), and the second creature takes necrotic damage equal to the roll's total, as wails of the dead sound around them for a moment. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Tokens of the Departed.title: Tokens of the Departed
Tokens of the Departed.desc_long:
When a creature you can see dies within 30 feet of you, you can use your reaction to open your free hand and cause a Tiny trinket to appear there, called a soul trinket. The DM determines the trinket's form or has you roll on the Trinkets table in the Player's Handbook to generate it.
You can have a maximum number of soul trinkets equal to your proficiency bonus, and you can't create one while at your maximum.
You can use soul trinkets in the following ways:
- While a soul trinket is on your person, you have advantage on death saving throws and Constitution saving throws, for your vitality is enhanced by the life essence within the object.
- When you deal Sneak Attack damage on your turn, you can destroy one of your soul trinkets that's on your person and then immediately use Wails from the Grave, without expending a use of that feature.
- As an action, you can destroy one of your soul trinkets, no matter where it's located. When you do so, you can ask the spirit associated with the trinket one question. The spirit appears to you and answers in a language it knew in life. It's under no obligation to be truthful, and it answers as concisely as possible, eager to be free. The spirit knows only what it knew in life, as determined by the DM.
Tokens of the Departed.desc_short: When a creature you can see dies within 30 feet of you, you can use your reaction to open your free hand and cause a Tiny trinket to appear there, called a soul trinket. The DM determines the trinket's form or has you roll on the Trinkets table in the Player's Handbook to generate it.

Ghost Walk.title: Ghost Walk
Ghost Walk.recovers: LR or destroy a soul trinket
Ghost Walk.desc_long: At 13th level, you can phase partially into the realm of the dead, becoming like a ghost. As a bonus action, you assume a spectral form. While in this form, you have a flying speed of 10 feet, you can hover, and attack rolls have disadvantage against you. You can also move through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain, but you take 1d10 force damage if you end your turn inside a creature or an object. You stay in this form for 10 minutes or until you end it as a bonus action. To use this feature again, you must finish a long rest or destroy one of your soul trinkets as part of the bonus action you use to activate Ghost Walk.

Death's Friend.title: Death's Friend
Death's Friend.desc_long:
At 17th level, your association with death has become so close that you gain the following benefits:
- When you use your Wails from the Grave, you can now deal the necrotic damage to both the first and the second creature.
- At the end of a long rest, a soul trinket appears in your hand if you don't have any soul trinkets, as the spirits of the dead are drawn to you.

Skirmisher.title: Skirmisher
Skirmisher.desc_long: Starting at 3rd level, you are difficult to pin down during a fight. You can move up to half your speed as a reaction when an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet of you. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

Survivalist.title: Survivalist
Survivalist.desc_long: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency in the Nature and Survival skills if you don't already have it. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of those proficiencies.

Superior Mobility.title: Superior Mobility
Superior Mobility.desc_long: At 9th level, your walking speed increases by 10 feet. If you have a climbing or swimming speed, this increase applies to that speed as well.

Ambush Master.title: Ambush Master
